text:
Marta V.: hi team, new hire here. trying to finish observability setup and hit a couple odd things: 1) Grafana template var for $cluster only shows 'prod' — i need dev/staging options to test dashboards locally. 2) when i try to duplicate a dashboard i get a 403 on save-as. 3) Sentry login works but project list empty (no org access). 4) Datadog: do local agent runs show up in billing? want to avoid spiking usage while iterating. who should i nudge for each?

obs-bot: Welcome Marta! Please follow the Observability onboarding guide: https://go.redwood/onboard-observability and submit the access form: https://go.redwood/obs-access-request — DevEx triages requests M-F. :wave:

Leah (DevEx): welcome Marta! quick answers: Grafana vars -> usually a combination of variable query + folder perms. if you only see prod it's likely your SSO group lacks access to dev/staging namespaces. i can add you to the appropriate SSO group and re-share the folder. 403 on duplicate -> that's an ACL issue (need edit on the dashboard or folder). Sentry -> i'll re-send the invite and check you were added to the right SSO team. Datadog billing -> yes, telemetry to the org counts. use DD_ENV=dev + low sampling or no-cloud-upload for UI-only checks.

Leah (DevEx): quick steps: 1) i'll add you to `team:web` SSO group now. log out of SSO and back in. 2) if duplicate still 403 after that, DM me the dashboard UID and i can grant dashboard-edit on just that UID. 3) i'll re-send Sentry invite to marta.v@redwood.com and add you to project readers.

Omar (Platform): FYI Grafana pulls cluster list for that var from our metrics index. If your role can't list dev clusters, the var will be empty. I triggered an SSO group sync for you and shared folder `team/web`. If you prefer immediate access, i can temporarily add your user as a viewer+edit on that exact folder.

Maya (Observability): Datadog notes: run with DD_ENV=dev and set DD_TRACE_SAMPLE_RATE=0.02 for local dev. For pure UI exploration run the agent with local-forwarding/no-upload:
```bash
docker run --rm -e DD_API_KEY=$DD_API_KEY -e DD_ENV=dev datadog/agent:latest agent run --no-cloud-upload
```
This shows spans/metrics locally without sending them to the cloud. Also, prefer ephemeral keys from 1Password path: redwood/integrations/datadog/ephemeral for local dev.

Marta V.: thanks everyone. i logged out/in and can now see dev/staging in the cluster var, but duplicate still 403. Sentry invite arrived but project list blank until i accepted in the other tab, fixed now.

Leah (DevEx): got the duplicate 403 — patched your user on that dashboard UID (UID: aB12cd34). you should be able to duplicate and save now. For future small edits, file the tiny-edit form: https://go.redwood/obs-edit-request so we can track changes.

Omar (Platform): note on quotas: dev org has soft quotas and an alert if CI or local pushes exceed 10k traces/min. If you hit that, platform will throttle and message the owner. We also have a sandbox org (`redwood-sandbox`) for heavy experiments. DM me if you want a sandbox key.

Marta V.: duplicate worked, saved as sandbox copy, and i used the no-cloud-upload mode for a manual trace test. one tiny ask: how do i create a saved Sentry search to show errors only from my feature branch?

Maya (Observability): in Sentry use search `is:unresolved release:feature/* environment:dev` then Save Search -> name it \"Marta: Feature Errors\" and pin to the top. i can add that saved search to your sidebar if you want.

Marta V.: saved it, perfect. thanks for the quick help everyone :tada: closing thread unless anything else needed.

Leah (DevEx): welcome aboard Marta! DM us any time for follow-ups. :raised_hands:
